meta.desc: View hidden EXIF metadata from your photos online. Check camera settings, GPS location, and more with our free metadata viewer.

input.title: View Image Metadata
input.desc: Upload an image to reveal its hidden EXIF data and information.

content.title: Online Image EXIF Viewer
content.p1: Every photo allows you to capture more than just an image; it captures data. Our Image Metadata Viewer extracts this hidden information, known as EXIF data, to show you exactly how and where a photo was taken.
content.p2: From camera model and shutter speed to GPS coordinates and software used, you can view comprehensive details about any image file.

exif.title: Full EXIF Data
exif.desc: See camera settings like ISO, aperture, shutter speed, and focal length.

gps.title: GPS Location
gps.desc: Check if your photo contains geolocation data (latitude/longitude).

technical.title: Technical Specs
technical.desc: View exact dimensions, color space, and file compression details.

how_to.title: How to View Metadata
list: Upload your image (JPG, PNG, TIFF, etc.).
Wait a moment for the tool to scan the file.
Browse the generated table of metadata properties.
Check for camera info, dates, copyright, and more.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: EXIF (Exchangeable Image File Format) is standard information stored in image files by digital cameras and smartphones. It includes settings like date, time, and camera model.
